-- Generated by ShoshinVim. This configuration has no ShoshinVim runtime dependency.
local config_root = vim.fn.fnamemodify(debug.getinfo(1, 'S').source:sub(2), ':p:h')
vim.opt.rtp:prepend(config_root)
vim.g.shoshinvim_config_root = config_root
local function load(name)
  if vim.g.shoshinvim_probe then return require('user_config.' .. name) end
  local ok, err = pcall(require, 'user_config.' .. name)
  if not ok then
    vim.schedule(function() vim.notify('ShoshinVim: ' .. name .. ' did not load: ' .. tostring(err), vim.log.levels.ERROR) end)
  end
end
load('options')
load('icons')
load('navigation')
load('diagnostics')
load('completion')
load('formatting')
if not vim.g.shoshinvim_probe then
  local ok, err = pcall(require, 'user_config.user')
  if not ok then vim.notify(tostring(err), vim.log.levels.WARN) end
end

lua/user_config/navigation.lua:
-- Generated by ShoshinVim. Put manual changes in user.lua.
-- Search commands. Shortcuts call these, so they work with any finder.
local function command(name, run, desc) vim.api.nvim_create_user_command(name, run, { desc = desc }) end
local function config_root() return vim.g.shoshinvim_config_root or vim.fn.stdpath('config') end
local function with(module, run)
  return function()
    local ok, m = pcall(require, module)
    if not ok then return vim.notify(module .. ' is not installed yet. Open ShoshinVim and download plugins.', vim.log.levels.WARN) end
    local done, err = pcall(run, m) -- For example Git status outside a Git repository.
    if not done then vim.notify(tostring(err), vim.log.levels.WARN) end
  end
end
if vim.fn.executable('rg') == 1 then vim.o.grepprg = 'rg --vimgrep --smart-case' end
command("ShoshinFiles", function() vim.ui.input({ prompt = 'Find file: ', completion = 'file' }, function(path) if path and path ~= '' then vim.cmd.edit(vim.fn.fnameescape(path)) end end) end, "Find files")
command("ShoshinGrep", function() vim.ui.input({ prompt = 'Search text: ' }, function(text) if text and text ~= '' then vim.cmd('silent grep! ' .. vim.fn.shellescape(text)); vim.cmd.copen() end end) end, "Search text in the project")
command("ShoshinGrepWord", function() vim.cmd('silent grep! ' .. vim.fn.shellescape(vim.fn.expand('<cword>'))); vim.cmd.copen() end, "Search the word under the cursor")
command("ShoshinRecent", function() vim.cmd('browse oldfiles') end, "Recent files")
command("ShoshinBuffers", function() vim.cmd('ls'); vim.ui.input({ prompt = 'Buffer: ' }, function(b) if b and b ~= '' then vim.cmd.buffer(b) end end) end, "Open buffers")
command("ShoshinDiagnostics", function() vim.diagnostic.setqflist() end, "Project diagnostics")
command("ShoshinHelpPages", function() vim.ui.input({ prompt = 'Help topic: ', completion = 'help' }, function(t) if t and t ~= '' then vim.cmd.help(t) end end) end, "Search Neovim help")
command("ShoshinKeymaps", function() vim.cmd('map') end, "Search keymaps")
command("ShoshinCommands", function() vim.api.nvim_feedkeys(':', 'n', false) end, "Search commands")
command("ShoshinResume", function() vim.notify('Resume needs a finder plugin', vim.log.levels.INFO) end, "Reopen the last search")
command("ShoshinGitStatus", function() vim.cmd('!git status --short') end, "Changed files (Git)")
command("ShoshinBufferLines", function() vim.api.nvim_feedkeys('/', 'n', false) end, "Search in this file")
command("ShoshinConfigFiles", function() vim.cmd.edit(vim.fn.fnameescape(config_root())) end, "Find Neovim config files")
command("ShoshinExplore", function() vim.cmd.Explore() end, "Project explorer")
command("ShoshinTerminal", function()
  local ok, snacks = pcall(require, 'snacks')
  if ok then snacks.terminal.toggle() else vim.cmd('botright 12split | terminal') end
end, "Terminal")
command("ShoshinBufferDelete", function()
  local ok, snacks = pcall(require, 'snacks')
  if ok then snacks.bufdelete() else vim.cmd.bdelete() end
end, "Close buffer")
